alwaysAllowDesc: Tools the user has approved across the board. Future calls skip the approval dialog.
alwaysAllowEmpty: No tools have been added to the always-allow list yet.
astGrepDesc: AST-aware code search and refactoring (ast_grep_search / ast_grep_replace) across 25 languages, backed by the ast-grep CLI. Matches code structure with meta-variables ($VAR, $$$), not plain text. Desktop only; the binary is probed lazily.
codeGraphDesc: Structural code intelligence over a tree-sitter symbol graph (codegraph_search / node / callers / callees / impact / context / explore / files). Sub-millisecond queries grep can't answer: where a symbol is defined, who calls it, and blast radius. Read-only; desktop only.
coreFilesDesc: Full coding-agent toolkit for non-Anthropic models: search, read, patch, shell, waitable background commands, and structured session tasks with dependencies. Read-only tools run freely; filesystem and shell mutations require per-call approval.
dependencyResearchDesc: Clone a dependency's source repository into an ignored .cognia/clonedeps/ workspace (clone_dep_source / list_cloned_deps) so the agent can read library internals. HTTPS only, idempotent, no build scripts run. Desktop only.
webcloneDesc: Snapshot a live web page (web_clone / web_clone_convert) — download its HTML plus all CSS/JS/image/font assets into a self-contained single file or a directory bundle, with optional component extraction and Vue/React/Angular/Svelte/jQuery codegen. Private/loopback targets are blocked unless opted in. Desktop only.
description: Per-category toggles for the in-process cognia-tools MCP server. Each category exposes a different set of tools to the agent.
desktopRequiredDesc: These tools run inside the local sidecar process. They are unavailable in the web build.
environmentManagementDesc: Read environment variables and system info. Secret-shaped keys (KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASSWORD) are redacted unless the agent explicitly opts in.
fileExtrasDesc: hash, diff, content_search, file_info and other ops not covered by the SDK's built-in Read / Write / Glob / Grep.
gitOperationsDesc: Structured wrappers for git status, diff, log, branch, remote, tag, and repo inspection. Read-only.
lspIntelligenceDesc: Language-server-backed code navigation — go-to-definition, find references, hover types, document symbols, and live diagnostics. Desktop only; language servers spawn lazily on first use.
permissionsDesc: Tools that require approval pop up a per-call dialog. Add a tool to the always-allow list (below) to skip the prompt. Disable a category to remove its tools from the agent entirely.
processManagementDesc: List, search, start and terminate local processes. Off by default — start/terminate are high-risk.
selfInvokeCardDesc: Let the agent call tools to drive itself — load a skill's instructions, or run a slash command. Host-routed; works in the browser and the CLI. Off by default.
shellExecutionDesc: Allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard for shell commands. Off by default — overlaps SDK Bash and is high-risk.
skillToolDesc: Expose the Skill tool so the agent can load a skill's instructions mid-task.
slashToolDesc: Expose the SlashCommand tool so the agent can run a registered slash command. Built-in UI commands return guidance to run them from the composer.
teamCollabToolDesc: Let teammates collaborate during a team run — message peers, share the blackboard, open or vote in a consensus, and delegate sub-tasks. Only applies to Agent Team sessions.
terminalReplDesc: Agent-private persistent PTY sessions backed by node-pty (lazy loaded). Use for stateful REPLs (python / sql / claude-code) where the agent needs to hold state across multiple writes. Orthogonal to the dock-relay path — REPL is invisible to the user.
title: Built-in tools

tools.astGrepReplace: Refactor code by AST-aware structural rewrite across 25 languages. Dry-run by default; set dry_run:false to write.
tools.astGrepSearch: Search code by AST structure (meta-variables $VAR / $$$) across 25 languages. Read-only; more precise than text grep.
tools.checkProgramAllowed: Test whether a program would be allowed to start_process.
tools.cloneDepSource: Clone a dependency's HTTPS source repo into .cognia/clonedeps/ (idempotent) so you can read its internals.
tools.webClone: Snapshot a live web page — download its HTML plus all CSS/JS/image/font assets into a self-contained single file or a directory bundle, with optional component extraction + framework codegen. Writes into the workspace.
tools.webCloneConvert: Run component extraction + framework codegen on an existing local snapshot (bundle directory or single HTML) without re-fetching. Generates Vue/React/Angular/Svelte/jQuery components.
tools.contentSearch: Search file contents (substring or regex) with line numbers.
tools.coreApplyPatch: Apply a unified diff across one or more files atomically (create / modify / delete).
tools.coreBash: Execute a free-form shell command (approval-gated; output keeps the tail).
tools.coreBashOutput: Read new output from a background shell started with bash(run_in_background).
tools.coreEdit: Replace an exact string in a file, with whitespace-tolerant fuzzy fallback.
tools.coreGlob: Find files by glob pattern, sorted by modification time (newest first).
tools.coreGrep: Search file contents with a regex (ripgrep-backed; content / files / count modes).
tools.coreKillShell: Terminate a background shell started with bash(run_in_background).
tools.coreListShells: List background shells with status, working directory, timing, and exit details.
tools.coreMonitor: Wait for a background job, output pattern, shell predicate, or upstream task; long waits become durable background watches.
tools.coreMonitorCancel: Cancel a durable background watch owned by this session.
tools.coreMonitorList: List this session's active and settled background watches.
tools.coreMultiEdit: Apply multiple string replacements to one file atomically.
tools.coreNotebookEdit: Edit a Jupyter notebook cell (replace / insert / delete) by cell id or number.
tools.coreRead: Read a text file with line numbers; pages large files; lists directories.
tools.coreTaskCreate: Create a structured session task and return its stable id.
tools.coreTaskGet: Read one structured task with dependencies, owner, metadata, and timestamps.
tools.coreTaskList: List structured session tasks and their current dependency state.
tools.coreTaskUpdate: Update task state, details, ownership, metadata, dependencies, or delete it.
tools.coreTodoWrite: Update the session task list shown to the user.
tools.coreWrite: Create or overwrite a file (requires a prior read of existing files).
tools.currentTime: Get the current date and time (UTC plus a localized string for a given timezone).
tools.directoryDelete: Delete a directory. Recursive option for non-empty trees.
tools.fileAppend: Append UTF-8 text to a file. Creates the file if missing.
tools.fileBinaryWrite: Write a base64-encoded binary payload to a file.
tools.fileExists: Check if a path exists. Returns isFile / isDirectory.
tools.fileHash: Compute md5 / sha1 / sha256 / sha512 of a file. Read-only.
tools.fileMove: Move a file across or within filesystems.
tools.fileSearch: List files under a directory matching an optional glob and extension filter.
tools.getEnv: Read a single env var. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.getProcess: Get a single process by PID.
tools.getProcessManagerStatus: Sidecar process manager state and tracked PID count.
tools.getTrackedProcesses: PIDs the agent has started this session.
tools.gitCommit: Create a commit from staged changes. Requires approval.
tools.gitDiff: Diff working tree or staged area.
tools.gitHistory: Commit history for a path or set of paths.
tools.gitLog: Recent commits with hash / author / date / subject.
tools.gitRepoInspect: Top-level path, current branch, HEAD hash, upstream.
tools.gitStage: Stage files for commit (git add). Requires approval.
tools.gitTag: List tags, optionally filtered by glob.
tools.listClonedDeps: List the dependency source repos already cloned into .cognia/clonedeps/ (reads the manifest).
tools.listEnv: List process env vars. Secrets are redacted unless revealed.
tools.lspDiagnostics: Get current compiler / linter diagnostics for a file.
tools.lspDocumentSymbols: List the symbols (classes, functions, variables) defined in a file.
tools.lspFindReferences: Find all references to the symbol at a position.
tools.lspGotoDefinition: Find where the symbol at a position is defined.
tools.lspHover: Get type / signature / documentation for the symbol at a position.
tools.searchProcesses: Find processes whose name contains a substring.
tools.shellExecuteAdvanced: Run a single program with argv, gated by allowlist + blocklist + dangerous-pattern guard. Always requires approval.
tools.startProcess: Start a program from the allowlist. Requires approval.
tools.systemInfo: Platform, arch, node version, cpu, memory, uptime, hostname.
tools.terminalReplRead: Drain accumulated REPL output (default: destructive read). Returns '{data, truncated, exited, exitCode}'.
tools.terminalReplSpawn: Open a persistent interactive PTY (e.g. python / sql REPL). Returns sessionId for subsequent writes / reads.
tools.terminalReplWrite: Write bytes into a REPL session's stdin. Non-blocking — pair with terminal_repl_read.
tools.terminateProcess: Terminate a PID (default: only PIDs this session started).
tools.topMemoryProcesses: Top N processes by resident memory.

webAllowPrivateDesc: Let web_fetch reach localhost and private-network hosts (10.x, 192.168.x, 169.254.x cloud metadata). Off by default to block SSRF — enable only for trusted local development.
webAlwaysDistillDesc: Run every fetched page through the utility model before the agent sees it, even without a question — the agent never reads raw page text, narrowing the prompt-injection surface. Needs a configured model; slightly more cost per fetch.
webCardDesc: Web search and fetch (web_search / web_fetch). On by default — works in the browser and the CLI. web_search needs a provider configured in Settings → Search.
webNativeAnthropicDesc: On the Anthropic path, use Claude's built-in WebSearch / WebFetch (server-side extraction + citations) instead of the multi-provider tools. Other providers keep the multi-provider tools.
vectorToolDesc: Let the agent store and recall documents in the current project's vector memory. Collections are scoped to the linked project; a session without one cannot use these tools.
vectorToolDesktopOnly: Requires the desktop app — vector memory runs on the local native vector store.
